categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels, including detailed information about land parcel numbers, owners, property extents, and ownership classifications. The content focuses entirely on land registration and title settlement processes, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
